title: A complete linear system containing a closed-immersion subsystem is closed
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $\mathcal M$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $V\subseteq\Gamma(X,\mathcal M)$ be a finite-dimensional $k$-subspace whose associated morphism $j:X\to\mathbf P(V^\vee)_k$ [lem-weil-pbc-projective-space-functor-of-points] is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $j^*\mathcal O(1)\cong\mathcal M$. Then the morphism associated to the complete linear system $\Gamma(X,\mathcal M)$ is a closed immersion and pulls back $\mathcal O(1)$ to $\mathcal M$.

source.place: no Stacks tag states it; standard linear-projection argument: the projection from P(Gamma(X,M)^vee) to P(V^vee) is defined where the coordinates in V do not all vanish, cancellation of closed immersions along a separated morphism (Schemes 07RK (3) (Morphisms, closed-immersion cancellation; the earlier 01KT is the section-immersion lemma, corrected by L, reviewer R-cls)), and Morphisms Lemma 01W6 (a proper immersion has closed image)

proof.text: Invertibility supplies quasi-coherence and finite local freeness, hence finite presentation. Apply finiteDimensional_H_of_isProper in degree zero and transport along H.zeroLinearEquiv, with the field action given by globalSectionsRingHom. This works without a nonempty-scheme assumption.

source.place: 01NE, basis extension and projective-coordinate uniqueness; final closedness via etale.tex, 04XV

proof.text: Extend the independent family of global sections to a basis using Module.Basis.extend; finite-dimensionality makes its index type J finite. Convert each basis vector to a global section via unitHomEquiv and homOfGlobalSection. The old section values are included among the new ones. On each stalk their spans are therefore included, so generating_sections_iff_stalk_span transfers the original generation to the extended basis.

source.place: 01NE, basis extension and projective-coordinate uniqueness; final closedness via etale.tex, 04XV

proof.text: The unique integral morphism associated to generating sections pulls back the universal pair. Use its inverse images of standard charts as a cover with free generators. The native chart construction for any base morphism has the same integral composite by uniqueness of the universal pair and its chart formulas. The homOfGeneratingSections projection identities identify the two morphisms. The native twistRestrictHom and the adjoint-uniqueness comparison of pullbacks give the required section-preserving pullback isomorphism.

source.place: 01NE, basis extension and projective-coordinate uniqueness; final closedness via etale.tex, 04XV

proof.text: The old coordinate indexed by i is exactly the new coordinate indexed by f(i), so it is the linear combination with coefficient 1 at f(i) and 0 elsewhere, in global functions of Spec k. Apply mono_of_eq_sum_smul to the two section-preserving pairs. The original closed immersion is a monomorphism; hence the complete-system morphism is a monomorphism.

source.place: 01NE, basis extension and projective-coordinate uniqueness; final closedness via etale.tex, 04XV

proof.text: The relative projective space projection is proper, in particular separated. Its composite with the complete-system morphism equals the given proper structure morphism, so IsProper.of_comp makes the complete-system morphism proper. The proper-monomorphism characterization makes it a closed immersion. Retain the pullback isomorphism already obtained.

lean.statement: theorem completeLinearSystem_isClosedImmersion (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (M : X.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] : letI : Module k Γ(M, ⊤) := Module.compHom Γ(M, ⊤) (Scheme.globalSectionsRingHom k (X := X)) ∀ (I : Type u) [Finite I] (s : I → M.sections) (hs : Epi (M.freeHomEquiv.symm s)), LinearIndependent (M := Γ(M, ⊤)) k (fun i ↦ (s i).val (Opposite.op ⊤)) → IsClosedImmersion (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections I (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) M s hs) → Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections I (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) M s hs)).obj (ProjectiveSpace.twist I (Spec (.of k)) 1) ≅ M) → ∃ (J : Type u) (_ : Finite J) (t : J → M.sections) (ht : Epi (M.freeHomEquiv.symm t)), LinearIndependent (M := Γ(M, ⊤)) k (fun j ↦ (t j).val (Opposite.op ⊤)) ∧ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun j ↦ (t j).val (Opposite.op ⊤) : Set Γ(M, ⊤)) = ⊤ ∧ IsClosedImmersion (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections J (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) M t ht) ∧ Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections J (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) M t ht)).obj (ProjectiveSpace.twist J (Spec (.of k)) 1) ≅ M)
